title: U.S. House · Indiana's 9th District
area: Southeastern Indiana, including Columbus, Seymour, Madison, and the Ohio River counties.

context.text: Incumbent Erin Houchin ran unopposed in the May 5, 2026 Republican primary. Brad Meyer won the Democratic primary with 37.9% in a four-way field. Tonya Hudson advanced from the Libertarian Party's March 22, 2026 convention. Floyd Taylor filed as a declared write-in independent candidate.

summary.text: Erin Houchin is the Republican incumbent for Indiana's 9th Congressional District, first elected in 2022. She previously worked in Indiana state government and as a regional director for former U.S. Senator Dan Coats, and was endorsed by President Donald Trump in 2026.

background.text: Born in Salem, Indiana in 1976; earned a bachelor's degree from Indiana University and a master's degree in political management from George Washington University.

Career experience includes owning a business, founding and serving as president of Contend Communications, and working for the Indiana Department of Child Services, Community Alliance Promoting Education, New Hope Services, and Prevent Child Abuse Indiana.
Served as southeast Indiana regional director for former U.S. Senator Dan Coats (R) and as a governor's appointee to the Indiana Commission for Women.
For the 2023-2024 Congress, served on the Committee on Education and the Workforce, the Committee on Financial Services, and the Committee on Rules.
Received the presidential endorsement of Donald Trump in 2026.

candidates.name: Brad Meyer
candidates.ballotNote: Won the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary with 37.9% of the vote in a four-way field.

summary.text: Brad Meyer is the Democratic nominee for Indiana's 9th Congressional District, campaigning on affordability, universal healthcare, and defending democratic institutions. He has been endorsed by Indivisible Southeast Indiana and the Progressive Voters Network.

priorities.text: Says wages have stalled while housing, healthcare, and education costs have squeezed middle-class families, and calls for economic reforms aimed at fairness.
priorities.quote: Wages have stalled while costs keep rising. Housing, healthcare, and education are squeezing families into bankruptcy.

priorities.text: Supports building on Medicare to guarantee universal healthcare coverage.
priorities.quote: Universal healthcare is a proven solution. By building on programs like Medicare, we can guarantee coverage for every resident, end medical bankruptcies, and free people to choose their doctor without fear of financial ruin.

priorities.text: Says he will work to restore institutional checks on power and protect the Department of Education from what he describes as partisan threats.

positions.summary: Supports building on Medicare toward universal healthcare coverage.
positions.quote: By building on programs like Medicare, we can guarantee coverage for every resident, end medical bankruptcies, and free people to choose their doctor without fear of financial ruin.

candidates.name: Tonya Hudson
candidates.ballotNote: Advanced from the Libertarian Party's March 22, 2026 convention.

summary.text: Tonya Hudson is the Libertarian nominee for Indiana's 9th Congressional District, a real estate broker from Indianapolis who has run in prior elections on reducing taxes and government regulation.

background.text: Born in Indianapolis, Indiana; graduated from John Marshall High School. Career experience includes working as a real estate broker.
Has been affiliated with the Lions Club and the Indiana Association of Realtors.

priorities.text: Supports reducing the tax burden, abolishing the IRS, and rolling back regulations she says hinder small businesses, farmers, and entrepreneurs.
priorities.quote: We, as a People, need to reduce the tax burden and give the people their money back. Abolish the IRS. Roll back the rules, regulations and red tape that hinder small businesses, farmers and entrepreneurs from becoming successful.

positions.summary: Supports reducing taxes broadly and abolishing the IRS rather than raising taxes.
positions.quote: We, as a People, need to reduce the tax burden and give the people their money back. Abolish the IRS.

candidates.name: Floyd Taylor
candidates.ballotNote: Declared write-in candidate for the general election.

summary.text: Floyd Taylor is an independent write-in candidate for Indiana's 9th Congressional District. No biography, campaign website content, or public statements of his positions were found as of this research.
